headline: FLASH FLOOD WARNING: Kurla and Dharavi Low-Lying Wards
description: Rapid water level rise detected along Mithi River basin. Inundation depth exceeding 0.7m expected in next 60 minutes.
instruction: Avoid low-lying subways and basement areas. Move to designated relief shelters or upper floors immediately.
area_description: Mumbai Municipal Ward L and G/North (Kurla & Dharavi)
